chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
If patience had not been created before trials, the believer would have shattered as an egg shatters upon a rock.

key_terms.الصَّبْرَ: patience; the God-given capacity to endure hardship steadfastly
key_terms.الصَّفَا: hard rock or stone; the surface against which the egg shatters
key_terms.الْبَلَاءِ: trial or affliction by which a person is tested
key_terms.الْبَيْضَةُ: the egg; used here as an image of fragility
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer; the one who possesses iman

ai.seo_question: Why is patience necessary for a believer in times of trial?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that sabr is a divine provision placed before affliction so that the believer can endure hardships. It emphasizes both the severity of trial and the essential protective role of patience in preserving the believer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.513 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If patience had not been created before trials, the believer would have shattered like an egg striking a rock."
